description: This file contains the implementation of a CBOR (Concise Binary Object Representation) factory using Jackson's dataformat CBOR library. It provides methods for serializing and deserializing JSON values to and from CBOR byte representations, specifically utilizing Jackson's CBORGenerator, CBORParser, and related classes. The class implements the CborFactory interface, offering functionalities like reading from byte arrays or ByteBuffers, converting JSON values into CBOR byte arrays, and parsing CBOR into JSON object models.

classes.name: JacksonCborFactory
classes.description: A final class implementing CborFactory that provides methods for CBOR serialization and deserialization using Jackson's dataformat CBOR library. Contains methods to read CBOR into JsonValue objects, to write JsonValue objects into CBOR byte arrays, and to create CBOR representations from maps and lists.
